scripts.lint: pnpm -r run lint && oxlint -c services/http/.oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings tests vitest.config.mts && oxlint -c services/http/.oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings scripts
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm -r run lint:fix && oxlint -c services/http/.oxlintrc.json --fix --deny-warnings tests vitest.config.mts && oxlint -c services/http/.oxlintrc.json --fix --deny-warnings scripts
scripts.format:check: pnpm -r run format:check && oxfmt -c services/http/.oxfmtrc.json --check tests vitest.config.mts package.json configuration scripts .github renovate.json
